Wednesday No-Drop

Chandler, AZ · Road

Wednesday No-Drop is a road group ride in Chandler, AZ. It rolls every Wednesday at 7:30 am from Varies each week around the Southeast Valley; see the RideWithGPS calendar.

For visitors

Visitors are always welcome. A helmet is required and earphones are not allowed. Check the RideWithGPS calendar for the week's start. Contact: rideleaders@pmbcaz.org (put 'Wednesday No-Drop' in the subject).

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wednesday No-Drop group ride

A weekday-morning no-drop road ride in the Southeast Valley, run by PMBC. Distance and pace follow whoever turns up, usually 20 to 32 miles at about 12 mph, with a stop for breakfast after. It moves its start around, so the calendar is the thing to check.
